title: Carina: portrait round 4 (dark roots, shoulder-length, wide-set eyes)
question: Is any of these Carina, or which parts (hair shape, face, glasses, clothes) should I combine?

media.caption: Mio and Kuro first (the style anchors), then the twelve finals with extra seeds of 4 and 8, each with STYLE and check marks. Jørgen after round 3: "Also try making some versions who have dark roots, shoulder length hair of various shapes, wide-spaced eyes, a few ... inspired by a Swedish film actress". Options 4, 8, 10 and 11 are the 'sleek high-cheekbone type' (high cheekbones, wide-set light eyes, defined brows, straight nose, full lips, sleek honey-blonde hair with darker roots), drawn as a fictional anime character in the cast's style. His other feedback: "many of the options become too glossy and not matching the style of the rest", so this round is matte with flat fills and bolder linework.
Eye spacing and gloss, round 3 (top) against round 4 (bottom): the gap between the eyes is wider and the surface is flat, not glossy.
